# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to research special enchantment spells to be used in creating
items.
@@ 3
Allows the caster to enchant an item with “empathy”.
@@ 4
Allows the caster to enchant an weapon with a +5 bonus or a +10 bonus versus a
general group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.) The weapon must have a +0
non-magical bonus to begin with due to material composition. The bonus
associated with this spell is not cumulative with other spell bonuses on this
list (i.e., casting both a Weapon I and a Weapon II will not yield the same
bonus as Weapon III).
@@ 5
As Weapon I, except armor and shields can be enchanted. The armor must have a
+0 non-magical bonus to begin with due to material composition.
@@ 6
As Weapon I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted to
give a Class I bonus.
@@ 7
Allows the caster to enchant an item with “Low Intelligence”.
@@ 8
As Weapon I, except weapons with a +10 bonus or a +15 bonus versus a general
group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.) may be enchanted. The weapon must
have a +5 non-magical bonus to begin with due to material composition.
@@ 9
As Weapon I, except armor and shields can be enchanted with a +10 bonus or a
+15 bonus versus a general group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.). The
armor must have a +5 non-magical bonus to begin with due to material
composition.
@@ 10
As Weapon I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted
with a Class II bonus.
@@ 12
Allows the caster to enchant an item with “Medium Intelligence”.
@@ 13
As Weapon I, except weapons with a +15 bonus or a +20 bonus versus a general
group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.) may be enchanted. The weapon must
have a +10 non-magical bonus to begin with due to material composition.
@@ 14
As Weapon I, except armor and shields can be enchanted with a +15 bonus or a
+20 bonus versus a general group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.). The
weapon must have a +10 non-magical bonus to begin with due to material
composition.
@@ 15
As Weapon I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted
with a Class III bonus.
@@ 17
Allows the caster to enchant an item with “High Intelligence”.
@@ 20
Allows the caster to enchant an item with “Very High Intelligence”.
@@ 25
As Weapon I, except weapons with a +20 bonus or a +25 bonus versus a general
group such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc., may be enchanted. The weapon must
have a +15 nonmagical bonus to begin with due to material composition.
@@ 30
As Weapon I, except armor and shields can be enchanted with a +20 bonus or a
+25 bonus versus a general group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.). The
weapon must have a +15 non-magical bonus to begin with due to material
composition.
@@ 35
As Weapon I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted
with a Class IV bonus.
@@ 50
As Weapon I, except weapons with a +25 bonus or a +30 bonus versus a general
group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.) may be enchanted. Weapon must be
made of Mithril or other substance that provides at least a +20 material
bonus.
@@ 55
As Weapon I, except armor and shields can be enchanted with a +25 bonus or a
+30 bonus versus a general group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.). Armor
must be make of Mithril or other substance that provides at least a +20
material bonus.
@@ 60
As Weapon I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted
with a Class V bonus.
@@ 70
Allows the caster to enchant an item with “Artifact Intelligence”.
@@ 80
As Weapon I, except weapons with a +30 bonus may be enchanted or a +35 bonus
versus a general group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.). Weapon must have
a material bonus of +25.
@@ 85
As Weapon I, except armor and shields can be enchanted with a +30 bonus or a
+35 bonus versus a general group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.). Armor
must have a material bonus of +25.
@@ 90
As Weapon I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted
with a Class VI bonus.
@@ 100
Allows the caster to enchant an item with “Legendary Intelligence”.
@@ 110
As Weapon I, except weapons with a +40 bonus or a +45 bonus versus a general
group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.) may be enchanted. The weapon must
have a material bonus of +30.
@@ 115
As Weapon I, except armor and shields can be enchanted with a +40 bonus or a
+30 bonus versus a general group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.). The
armor must have a material bonus of +30.
@@ 120
As Weapon I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted
with a Class VIII bonus.
@@ 140
As Weapon I, except weapons with a +50 bonus or a +55 bonus versus a general
group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.) may be enchanted. The weapon must
have a material bonus of +30.
@@ 145
As Weapon I, except armor and shields can be enchanted with a +50 bonus or a
+30 bonus versus a general group (such as Elves, greater Drakes, etc.). Armor
must have a material bonus of +30.
@@ 150
As Weapon I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted
with a Class X bonus.
@@ 180
As Weapon I, Armor I, and/or General I, except items can be enchanted with a
bonus equal to the casters level divided by three (e.g., a 198th lvl el
alchemist would enchant items with a bonus of +166), +5 may be added to this
bonus if it only applies versus a general group. Weapons and Armor must have a
material bonus of +30.
